title: Triangle Inequality OQ-01: Minkowski Inequality in L^p

problemStatement.formal: In normed additive groups and pseudometric spaces, prove the direct and reverse triangle inequalities for norms and distances, plus finite-sum norm bounds.
problemStatement.plain: Collects formal triangle-inequality facts across absolute values, normed spaces, metric spaces, and finite sums. The entry also records Lipschitz consequences for absolute value and norm functions.
whyMatters: Triangle inequalities are core estimates reused throughout analysis, geometry, and metric-space reasoning.
The file connects Mathlib's standard inequalities to named theorem-level entry points for downstream search.
The finite-sum bound supports later arguments that estimate norms of accumulated errors or series.

proven: `norm_triangle` proves the norm triangle inequality in any seminormed additive commutative group.
`norm_reverse_triangle` and `dist_reverse_triangle` record reverse triangle inequalities for norms and metrics.
`dist_triangle_ineq` packages the metric-space distance triangle inequality.
`norm_finset_sum_le` proves the iterated triangle inequality for finite sums.
`abs_lipschitz` and `norm_lipschitz` capture the Lipschitz continuity consequences.
open: Equality-case classifications and strict geometric characterizations are not the focus of this metadata entry.
knownResults.goal: Expose the proved triangle-inequality toolkit with searchable analysis and metric-space metadata.

knowledge.progressSummary: SOLVED: Formalized Minkowski's inequality in L^p as gallery entry triangle-inequality-oq-01 (Proofs/TriangleInequalityOQ01.lean, 14 theorems, 0 sorries, 0 axioms, VERIFIED). Inequality assembled at three levels — eLpNorm seminorm, MemLp closure, bundled Banach space Lp E p μ — plus the p<1 convexity-threshold failure via LpAddConst.
builtItems: Proofs/TriangleInequalityOQ01.lean: eLpNorm_add_le (Minkowski for the L^p seminorm, 1≤p)
eLpNorm_add_le_const + LpAddConst_eq_one (quasi-triangle inequality with constant 2^(1/p-1); =1 iff 1≤p)
memLp_add, memLp_finset_sum (L^p closed under addition/finite sums)
lp_norm_add_le, lp_norm_def, lp_abs_norm_sub_norm_le, lp_dist_triangle, lp_norm_sum_le (bundled Lp E p μ)
insights: Minkowski for L^p reduces entirely to MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_add_le on ℝ≥0∞; the bundled Banach norm version is a toReal corollary.
1≤p is the exact convexity threshold: Mathlib's LpAddConst p = 2^(1/p-1) equals 1 iff p≥1 (LpAddConst_of_one_le); for p<1 subadditivity genuinely fails.
The bundled NormedAddCommGroup (Lp E p μ) instance (needs Fact (1≤p)) yields the metric + reverse triangle inequalities for free via the generic normed-group API.
Minkowski is equivalent to closure of MemLp under addition (MemLp.add) — the vector-space structure of L^p.
nextSteps: Equality case: for 1<p<∞, equality in Minkowski iff f,g non-negatively proportional a.e.
